rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with an expanded blastocyst and notes intact/thinned zona, but it overstates confidence in good-quality features from a somewhat suboptimal image and includes a questionable comment about success declining with later blast stages; ICM/TE assessment is reasonable but not especially precise.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior IVF outcomes, tubal factor, sperm quality, endometrium, and lifestyle factors with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Overall logical and well structured, with prognosis appropriately centered on age-related aneuploidy risk despite good morphology; minor inconsistency in listing implantation lower than clinical pregnancy and some overinterpretation of stage significance.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading concepts and standard IVF counseling, including SET preference and hydrosalpinx evaluation; minor deviations include imprecise statements about blast stage prognostic hierarchy and somewhat broad PGT-A framing.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including hydrosalpinx clarification, luteal support adherence, uterine cavity reassessment, and discussion of PGT-A and protocol optimization.
